notes: P0-7 investment corrections (plan 4.7 adjusted by decisions A4, A6, A7, A8 and the lead ruling of 2026-10-05).

Decision A4 restores the original Scheme C thermal net revenue in both profiles (a universal exception to the Q1 freeze): VRE and storage keep gross revenue as profit. Decision A6: P4-02 (ROI/payback vs NPV) is not a defect; every amount is in constant base-year money and investment decisions are undiscounted by design, so no NPV, IRR or annuity hurdle is introduced.
Universal accounting corrections (cost ledger v2 memo lines, decision A7) are not listed here, so that they do not change the applied-corrections hash of either profile (P0-4/P0-6 precedent).

advisory.title: Thermal investment decided on gross revenue
advisory.summary: Before P0-7 the v2 investment module netted no running cost, so gas and biomass plants paid exactly their marginal cost looked profitable and were expanded (a CCGT priced at its marginal cost built 10.95 MW per 100 MW). The original Scheme C rule nets generated MWh x gen_cost (fuel, carbon, unit-time cost).

corrections.description: agent-investment 3.0.0 nets, for gas and biomass (and any asset with a fuel or carbon cost), generated MWh x (generation + fuel + carbon + unit_time cost) from the market income; the running cost comes from the PSM's value.agent-cashflow/v1 extension and a decidable thermal group without it fails closed. VRE and storage keep gross revenue = profit, bit-identical to 35aadb3 (decisions A4, A7).

advisory.title: Storage expansion headroom was always zero
advisory.summary: Before P0-7 the typed storage policy computed the surplus as accepted VRE minus demand, which is never positive, so no storage could be built; it also rebound a kernel global during the call.

corrections.description: value-corrected: new storage charges only from the surplus left after the existing fleet charged, published by the PSM per period (storage_headroom_inputs, from the rule set's declared column semantics: excess + curtailed for the corrected default PSM). A chronology other than one full year of 17520 half-hour periods gives zero headroom with reason partial_year_chronology; a PSM without the trace gives zero with reason leftover_trace_unavailable. No kernel global is written. The doctoral profile keeps the 35aadb3 path (zero headroom, decision Q1).

advisory.title: Power-battery cap counted three times
advisory.summary: Before P0-7 the same power cap was given to each of the 1C, 0.5C and 0.25C batteries, so together they could take three times the aligned-utilisation room.

corrections.description: value-corrected: the three power batteries share one pool of cap_fraction x power_room; agent-investment collects their requests first and scales them to each technology cap, then to the pool (allocate_capped_requests). A doctoral run that receives a pooled headroom row is refused. The doctoral profile keeps the per-technology copies (decision Q1).

advisory.title: Headline cost included run-of-river hydro compatibility capital
advisory.summary: Before P0-7 the headline system cost counted the existing-stock compatibility capital of natural-flow hydro (about GBP 10.96bn per year on the UK pack), a preserved accounting basis rather than a sourced CAPEX.

corrections.description: value-corrected: cost ledger v2 keeps the existing_stock_compatibility annualised capital out of the headline and lists it as the memo line existing_stock_compatibility.annualised_capital (the Runs page shows it as 'Memo: run-of-river hydro compatibility capital (excluded from headline)'). The doctoral headline keeps it, with the same memo line marked as included. VRE and storage fixed OPEX is a memo in both profiles (decision A7, universal accounting).
